Today’s discussion

A plan for about 50 minutes. Let her find each idea on the board before you open the engine line.

0-5 min · Ask her first

Which game felt harder? Ask her to show one moment she remembers from each game before you open the analysis.

5-18 min · Round 1, the knight on g5

Go to 7.Qf3 and ask where the knight goes after ...h6. At 9.Bxf7+, count what White gives and what White gets. Then try 9.Nd5 on the board.

18-25 min · Round 1, knight jumps

At 13.d3, find every square the c6 knight can reach. Let her find ...Ne2+ and ...Nxc2 before you show them.

25-40 min · Round 3, the diagonal

Draw the b3-g8 diagonal with an arrow. Walk through 10...f5, 13...Qe6 and 15...Be6. Then play 16.Nxe6 Qxe6 17.cxd5 and ask why the queen can't take on d5.

40-46 min · Round 3, the b-pawn

Follow White's pawn from c4 to b7. At 26.Rc8, ask what job the rook on b8 has.

46-50 min · One habit

Ask for her own rule in her own words. A good one: before I move, I look at their checks, captures and knight jumps, and at every open line to my king.
